calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 9 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS click_collect_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT 'orders dup ids' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS n FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_line dup ids', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_line dup receipt+line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'return dup ids', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'return dup sales_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'web lines w/o order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'WB lines not store 900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<>900 AND f.channel_code='WB'
UNION ALL SELECT 'orders with null fulfilment', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE fulfilment_type IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'dispatched orders no dispatch ts', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns web store not 900 on web line', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND rs.store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns of store lines at 900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id<>900 AND rs.store_id=900
UNION ALL SELECT 'ZZ test web lines', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test'

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT s.store_id, MIN(f.sale_date), MAX(f.sale_date), COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 20

WITH rr AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, rs.store_id AS ret_store, o.fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, (rs.store_id=900), 2, 3
)
SELECT fiscal_period, CASE WHEN ret_store=900 THEN 'at 900' ELSE 'at store' END AS loc, fulfilment_type, SUM(n) n, SUM(refund_net) refund
FROM (SELECT fiscal_period, ret_store, fulfilment_type, n, refund_net FROM rr) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS rpt_net_900, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_before, SUM(r.returns_net) AS rpt_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT fulfilment_type, status, COUNT(*) n, MIN(order_ts_utc) mn, MAX(order_ts_utc) mx, SUM(CASE WHEN pickup_store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_pickup
FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-15' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-28' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
